findings.title: Latch re-arms without newly completed material tool-group provenance
findings.observation: Length growth + full-history hash change + final matching group are insufficient to prove new tool progress. Direct exact38 calls re-arm on an unchanged old final group after prefix insertion; on an appended duplicate old complete group; and on incomplete/foreign rows preceding an otherwise valid final pair. These violate the explicitly required stale/duplicate/mixed/incomplete negative controls.
findings.impact: Can trigger another external summary attempt on stale or structurally incomplete history, consuming finite attempt/deadline budget and compacting a different history despite no proven newly completed group. Attempts/cooldowns/physical guard remain intact; no infinite reset or actual runtime reachability demonstrated.
findings.repair_condition: Require admitted same-turn new complete group provenance over unchanged prior history or an explicitly permitted pending-to-complete transition; reject stale/duplicate/foreign/mixed groups and unrelated inserted request rows. Preserve shared attempts/deadline/cooldowns and fail-closed guard.

findings.title: Bounded head can summarize opening user and system authority
findings.observation: The new rule finds the first non-system user by skipping every leading system row, but _protect_head_size counts only one system row. In the exact source with two leading systems the opening user is summarized; with three leading systems the third system is also summarized and loses system role. Old37 protection retains these authority rows for the same reproducer. Native real7 rows have no leading systems, so this is a supported compressor-shape contract defect rather than proof the observed native wire hits it.
findings.repair_condition: Preserve all leading essential system rows and the opening user verbatim, or restrict the lower-head exception to the explicitly supported shape and fail closed/no-fit for other authority layouts. Keep current user and complete/current pending tool groups protected.
